cases.name: single_add

cases.name: two_stream_concurrent_sleep
cases.purpose: Hidden-stream activities test concurrency and default-stream Event coverage.

cases.purpose: Discovery sees add only; timed calls add sin. Tests whether unexpected legitimate activity is rejected or silently excluded.
